en.moment_body: He came on with half an hour left and the game still level. In the 106th minute he found the roof of the net — and ran, not to the crowd, but to the bench. To the ones who had waited all tournament for a moment that might never arrive.
en.meta_title: Los Suplentes – Iconic Series IM-07 | MOMUTO
en.meta_description: He came on with half an hour left and the game still level. IM-07 of the Iconic Series captures the substitute's winner in the 106th minute, in archive sketch format. 220 GSM premium cotton tee.
